name: Pulse Music v4.2.8 - Instant Windows Startup, Glitch-Free Switching, Trust Seal & Device-Gated Dolby
body:
# Pulse Music v4.2.8 - Instant Windows Startup, Glitch-Free Switching, Trust Seal & Device-Gated Dolby

Official multi-platform release and global OTA update for **Android**, **Windows**, **Orion Store**, **F-Droid**, **Obtainium**, and **Web**.

---

### Audio Switching & Playback Stability (Android & Windows)
- **Glitch-Free Multitasking & Notifications**: Expanded Android `DefaultAudioTrackBufferSizeProvider` headroom, smoothed focus ducking and transient hold (`AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT`), and added clean gain fade-in/fade-out ramps around pause/resume so app switching never pops or crackles.
- **Shared WASAPI Desktop Stability**: Configured Windows `libmpv` with shared WASAPI mode (`audio-exclusive=no`), larger audio buffer and stream-silence keepalive, demuxer readahead, and elevated pump-thread priority to eliminate buffer underruns when switching desktop windows.

### Windows Desktop Upgrades
- **Instant Window Startup**: Opens the main window on frame 0 while Koin, Room/DataStore, `libmpv`, protocol registration, and update checks initialize asynchronously off the UI thread.
- **8D Cinematic Audio & Live Artwork**: Wired `CinematicAudioEffect` (`apulsator` orbital panning) into `libmpv` and desktop handler, repaired thumbnail resolution fallbacks and track transition sync across Now Playing and Mini Player.
- **Spotify Cookie Login (`sp_dc`)**: Rebuilt desktop Spotify authentication with multi-format cookie/cURL extraction for instant web session handoff.

### Windows Trust Seal & Clean Runtime Hygiene
- **In-App Publisher & Binary Trust Seal**: Added live Authenticode signature, publisher certificate thumbprint, and SHA-256 inspection in the desktop title bar, Settings, and About screens, with one-click access to Windows' native Certificate viewer and GitHub checksums.
- **Comprehensive Binary Signing & Zero Startup Shell Spawns**: Signed `Pulse.exe` and bundled unsigned DLLs (`libmpv-2.dll`, etc.), replaced runtime `powershell.exe` / `cmd.exe reg` subprocesses with in-process JNA Win32 Registry APIs and Inno Setup native shortcuts, and added an optional user-consented Trusted Publishers installer task.

### Supported-Device Gating for Dolby Audio
- **Hardware & Driver Enforcement**: Enforced authentic Dolby Atmos / Spatial Audio hardware detection on Android and Windows (APO/service/driver registry checks) across UI toggles, `SettingsViewModel`, and both audio engines (`MediaServiceHandlerImpl` and `JvmMediaPlayerHandlerImpl`), keeping 8D Cinematic Audio available on all devices.
changelog: Glitch-Free App Switching & Notifications: Larger Android/WASAPI audio buffers, smooth pause/resume/ducking gain ramps, and eliminated background playback pops
Instant Windows Startup & Desktop Fixes: Frame-0 desktop window open, restored 8D Cinematic Audio on libmpv, live album art transitions, and reliable desktop Spotify cookie login
Windows Trust Seal & Clean Signing: Live in-app Authenticode and SHA-256 verification seal, signed native binaries, zero runtime PowerShell/reg subprocesses, and optional installer certificate setup
Device-Gated Dolby Audio: Enforced Android and Windows hardware/APO support checks in UI and audio engines so Dolby Audio runs strictly on supported devices
